weights (kill forces baseline) fn->>db: PutItem if absent or ttl at or before now opt condition failed: another instance won fn->>db: GetItem, use the stored Arm end end fn->>arm: POST raw body, bearer, X-Route-* headers,
traceparent arm-->>fn: status fn-->>gs: 2xx and 4xx as 200 (4xx logged rejected),
5xx or timeout as 502
